description: Export rblock data to a file for later import or post-processing.

python_sdk_alternative.workaround: Use itasca.command('rblock export ...') via command interface

keywords.name: to-geometry
keywords.syntax: to-geometry [<s>] {slot <s> | split | to-3dec5 <s> [{constitutive <i> | group <s> [slot <i>] | material <i> | region <i>}]} ...
keywords.description: Options: slot <s>: If specified then the polygons of each rigid block are assigned the group name corresponding to the rigid block ID in slot s . This can be used to easily identify single rigid blocks without splitting each one into a different geometry set.; split: If specified, the split keyword results in each rigid block being exported into a dedicated geometry set. By default, all the rigid blocks are exported into one unique geometry set (see above).; to-3dec5 <s>[{constitutive <i> | group <s>[slot <i>] | material <i> | region <i>}]: Export rigid blocks to 3DEC 5.2 (or older) using the polyhedron face command. Options: constitutive <i>: Specify the constitutive model with default 1.; group <s>[slot <i>]: The exported rigid blocks are given group s (with default Default ) in slot i (with default 1 ).; material <i>: Specify the material model number with default 1.; region <i>: Specify the region with default 1.
